subject: general
question: What is the basic difference in food intake by Amoeba and Paramoecium?

options.text: Amoeba can take up food from entire cell surface Paramoecium only through specific spot
Amoeba takes up food through specific spot while paramoecium can take up from 2 spots
Amoeba can take up through entire cell surface and paramecium through 4 spots on its cells surface
Both of them can take up through the entire cell surface

solution:
The correct answer is __**Amoeba can take up food from entire cell surface Paramoecium only through specific spot**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Amoeba** can ingest food from any part of its cell surface.
 
• **Paramoecium** has a specialized region called the **oral groove** where food intake occurs.
